Title: Azure DevTest Labs: Configure resource group control for your lab

Body.Content:
As a lab owner, you now have the option to configure all your lab virtual machines (VMs) to be created in a single resource group. This helps you avoid reaching resource-group limits on your Microsoft Azure subscription.

To learn more about this feature, see the Azure blog.
